implementation: SageMath 10.7 (sage -python) with its NumPy; Python 3 standard library for summaries
notes: The records of the binary Goppa sets with n-5t-1 and n-4t-1 positions were produced before the --family and --extra options were added; their family and extra_closures fields were filled with the defaults (goppa, 0).
Timings were taken with many processes sharing the machine and differ between sets for that reason.
A rerun of two keys per small set reproduced every recorded rank and outcome; the selected Frobenius conjugate differed on some keys.
